verdict.rationale: Daytona sandboxes run in isolation with a dedicated kernel, filesystem, network stack and allocated resources, so agent-run code is separated from the host environment. A per-sandbox firewall restricts outbound destinations to prevent untrusted code from exfiltrating data. missing for 10: explicit documentation that host or user credentials are never exposed to sandbox code, a secrets-injection/scoping mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees.
